title: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and Extrahepatic Cancers.

snippet: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common chronic liver disease globally, and its high prevalence underscores the central role of metabolic dysregulation in its pathogenesis.
